notes.title: Koi Unleashed is back with a BIG update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35497221/6c9bbf3ee7c602e19c2747d410282aba72e17e04.png[/img]
It's been a while but the Koi is back with many changes and a new game mode:

[list]
[*] New game mode "Solo survivor"! You can now fight alone and still experience the game's story in full while maintaining the combat challenge. This mode allows you to do much more damage and all potions cooldown is reduced by 50%
[*] Major balance overhaul for a much more fun and fair experience on all bosses, The HP and damage has been tweaked and play tested thoroughly, and the mechanics have also been improved.
[*] Removed the "stop on hit" visual feature for a more smooth combat experience
[*] The game now also auto-saves before a boss fight
[*] Slightly decreased tutorial duration messages
[*] Added some UI combat tips on death
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with guild players stats not increasing with new levels
[*] Fixed a bug that would hide the combat UI
[*] Fixed selected player after blessing resurrection
[*] Fixed micro stuttering
[*] Fixed some localization errors
[/list]

Last but not least, the price has also significantly dropped to reflect the realistic value in 2024. Hope you enjoy Koi Unleashed!

notes.title: Post-Launch Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! It has been almost a week since the game launched and I want to thank everyone who played the game. I have listened to your feedback and made some necessary changes that will improve a lot the experience. I would also like to thank everyone that reported a bug, you have contributed to make Koi Unleashed a better and stable game.

Improvements:
- Increased the responsiveness of commands given to party members.
- Easy mode difficulty balancing adjustments to make it more fun for newcomers.
- Balanced the difficulty of the first Boss (Otoroshi) as it was reported to be too hard for a first encounter.
- New checkpoints that are closer to Bosses in case of a respawn.
- Introduced new visual clues for abilities done by Bosses Okiku, Aizen Myo'o and Benkei.
- Party AI improvements.
- Steam screenshot feature has been re-enabled.

Fixes:
- Fixed bug where some players would get stuck when transitioning from the first to the second map.
- Fixed bug with a popup window on game start.
- Fixed rare bug where the game would crash on the Aizen Myo'o encounter.
- Fixed glitch when doing a player selection on the party lineup menu.

Cheers!
